_sheet: Systems of the mod. One row = one C# class with one job. Preflight checks that each class exists in src and that every sheet it owns is referenced from it.

_columns.owns: sheets or generated tables this class is built from
_columns.dependsOn: other system ids, comma separated; - = none
_columns.testedBy: how it was verified (filled in during testing)

rows.owns: config (weights, offer count, caps, per-card values, keys)
rows.responsibility: BepInEx entry: loads every card setting into CardSettings.Current, Harmony PatchAll, subscriptions, per-frame tick
rows.testedBy: v0.3.0 in PEAK 2.6.b: loads, all 42 Harmony patches apply, 64-card deck built, no exceptions over three test runs

rows.responsibility: every tunable number: rarity weights, offer count, duplicates, Mythics on/off, stamina-cost cap, max-stamina floor, per-card enable, modifier values and parameters; the fingerprint of every shared gameplay setting, compared between players
offers: roll a rarity by weight, pick inside it; no duplicates, solo filter, no chained draws, Double Down cap, Mythics once per run, Bargain needs a target
rows.testedBy: Unit tests (offer, solo, owned, bonus, Double Down, Bargain, claimed Mythics, weights)

rows.responsibility: folds active modifiers from scratch each frame: multiplicative percentages, additive flat stamina, 60% cost cap and 50 max-stamina floor for normal cards, Mythics past the caps, set overrides; StatComposites combines channels exactly as the hooks apply them, and BuildStats lists them (now and always-on) for the Current Build screen
rows.testedBy: Unit tests (stacking, caps, Mythic overrides, no drift)

rows.class: CampfireCards.Core.Cooldown + CampfireCards.Core.Charge + CampfireCards.Core.DelayedInjuryQueue + CampfireCards.Core.ReviveArbiter + CampfireCards.Core.SpawnLedger + CampfireCards.Core.ItemTransaction + CampfireCards.Core.ThornsLedger + CampfireCards.Core.PerKeyBiomeCharge
rows.responsibility: Unity-free timers and ledgers: cooldowns, per-biome and per-run charges, latches, Momentum and Pulse machines, delayed Injury, host revive arbitration (reset per run, victims forgotten on leave), once-per-fire item rewards, one decision per item use (Lucky Lunch), Thorns scaling of new thorns only, Loaded Dice rolls
rows.testedBy: Unit tests (Second Wind, charges, cooldown, Momentum, Pulse, Delayed Consequences, arbiter incl. consecutive runs and overlapping requests, spawn ledger, item transaction, thorns ledger, Loaded Dice)

rows.responsibility: every player's synced collection and pick flags; for the local scout, gathers self modifiers (with conditions) and nearby teammates' auras each frame and applies the field-based channels from captured base values
